Glance Speedlab
================

A measurement-first working paper and reproducible local demo for live-camera Glance inference.
21 preregistered experiments were run on Apple M5, 32 GB unified memory.
Reference option: PyTorch/MPS FP16, 358.5 ms fresh-frame p50.
Experimental option: MLX 8-bit, 259.6 ms fresh-frame p50 (1.381x; 27.6% lower).
Guardrail: 84/84 fixed-suite decisions matched; maximum probability drift 0.039.
Try both locally: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/glance-speedlab
Use the opt-in MLX backend: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/glance
Full paper and evidence: https://github.com/yoheinakajima/glance-speedlab/blob/main/paper/PAPER.md
